Meet Just Baked Cakes and Pies

Desserts that remind you of Grandma

Just Baked Cakes and Pies

Just Baked Cakes and Pies is a dessert shop and bakery in Harrisburg, PA, listed by Visit Hershey-Harrisburg and the Harrisburg Bakery Crawl as inside the Midtown Scholar Bookstore. Its own description: 'Dessert Shop/Bakery offering an assortment of delicious baked goods.'

Reviews single out the sweet potato pie and the strawberry cheesecake. Custom cakes are ordered ahead by phone at (717) 236-3626.

Walk-in counter

Walk in during open hours, Thursday to Saturday. Custom cakes are ordered ahead by phone.

Inside Midtown Scholar

The counter sits inside the Midtown Scholar Bookstore on Verbeke St in Harrisburg.
